description: This file defines an interface for a JSON state data manager used within storage providers. It specifies methods for deleting, reading, and writing JSON-serialized data, serving as a lower-level component that handles data persistence for grain state management in an Orleans-based system.

classes.name: IJSONStateDataManager
classes.description: Interface for managing JSON state data, enabling deletion, reading, and writing of JSON data in storage.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the grain state associated with a given key from the collection.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads grain state as a JSON string from storage.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes JSON string data to the storage for a specified key.

calls: System.Threading.Tasks.Task Write(string collectionName, string key, string entityData)
